title.t: A signed listing change names a field the record does not have

when.t: A signed change names a field outside Agent 05's listing fields (beds, baths, square footage, price, status, remarks, address, photos).

steps.t: Agent 05 enters nothing.
It asks the authorized user, naming the field.

never.t: Put the value in the nearest-looking field.

test.t: A listing on record; the authorized user signs a change setting lot_acres to 0.5.

title.t: A listing portal shows different data than the MLS

when.t: A portal shows data different from the MLS record.

steps.t: The rule: correct the source record, then check every portal again.
Not built: there is no MLS or portal connection, so nothing can start it.

never.t: Fix one portal and leave the source wrong.

title.t: Two signed changes to the same field disagree

when.t: Two signed changes to the same field, from different signers, have different values.

steps.t: The first change was already carried out when it arrived. Agent 05 does not carry out the second, undoes nothing, and asks the authorized user; the second change is not kept, so it must be signed again if wanted.
No way in yet: the console and the Desk sign with one key, and the signer list that would name two different signers is not armed.

title.t: A portal is still out of date after the check window

when.t: A portal still shows old data after the allowed time.

steps.t: The rule: record it, tell the authorized user, and never mark it complete.
Not built: there is no MLS or portal connection, so nothing can start it.

title.t: A status change arrives without its required document

when.t: A signed change to sold names no closing document, or to pending names no signed contract.

steps.t: Agent 05 does not change the status and asks the authorized user, naming the document needed.

never.t: Change the status before the document is named.

you_see.t: A question naming the required document.

test.t: A listing on record; the authorized user signs a change to sold with no closing document.

title.t: A status change arrives without a valid signature

when.t: An instruction to change a listing arrives unsigned.

steps.t: The dispatcher refuses it before Agent 05 sees it, records an integrity violation and notifies the authorized user.
The status does not change.

never.t: Treat a verbal or emailed instruction as authority.

test.t: A listing on record; an unsigned instruction to withdraw it arrives.

when.t: The MLS refuses an entry on one of its rules.

steps.t: The rule: record the rejection as given, tell the authorized user, never change the data to pass.
Not built: there is no MLS or portal connection, so nothing can start it.

never.t: Change data to pass the MLS's check.

title.t: A signed price differs from the agreement amendment

when.t: A signed price change names an agreement amendment price that differs.

steps.t: Agent 05 does not change the price and asks the authorized user, with both amounts.

never.t: Pick one of the two prices.

you_see.t: A question saying the price conflicts with the amendment.

test.t: A listing on record; the authorized user signs a price of 440,000 naming an amendment at 435,000.

title.t: Someone asks to fill in buyer-broker compensation

when.t: A signed change names the buyer-broker compensation field, or carries a compensation offer.

steps.t: Agent 05 enters nothing and raises a legal-line alert naming the request. The alert gives the reason: compensation offers are prohibited on the MLS since August 17, 2024.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert about the compensation request.

test.t: A listing on record; the authorized user signs a change setting buyer_broker_comp to 2.5%.

title.t: The approved description's square footage differs from the record

when.t: The approved description from Agent 04 states a square footage different from the listing record.

steps.t: The record wins: Agent 05 logs the discrepancy and sends Agent 04 the record's figure; Agent 04 redrafts and the new draft goes through Compliance again.
Agent 05 sends this correction once per listing. If a second draft still differs, it holds for the authorized user and nothing goes live. The test does not reach this second case.
Only square footage is compared.

Agent 04 sends each approved draft to Agent 12 as well as to Agent 05. In the test the first (1,800 sq ft) draft reached Agent 12 before the listing was active, so Agent 12 only kept it; the copy it later published, held for the authorized user's release, says 2,000 sq ft.

never.t: Let a description that contradicts the record go out.

you_see.t: The corrected description; the discrepancy in the history.

test.t: The record says 2,000 sq ft; the first description used the 1,800 sq ft tax record. After the correction the released copy says 2,000 sq ft, the listing goes live once, and the exchange is not suspended as a loop.

title.t: A withdrawal is signed while the listing is under contract

when.t: A signed withdrawal (or, since 2026-10-28, an expiry) arrives for a listing set to pending.

steps.t: Agent 05 does not change the status; it raises a legal-line alert and sends a notice to Compliance.

never.t: Change status under a live contract on its own.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert saying a withdrawal was requested while under contract.

test.t: A listing goes to pending with a contract named; then the authorized user signs a withdrawal.

title.t: A vacant listing gets a property check ordered on each daily run (every day, the owner's interval)

when.t: The authorized user marks a listing vacant.

steps.t: Agent 05 starts a vacancy watch and logs it.
On each daily run it asks Agent 09 for a property check (every day unless the authorized user signs another interval).
Agent 09 books the first one; the booking waits for the authorized user's release. While it is open, no second one is booked, and the authorized user is told once.

never.t: Book a second check while one is open.

you_see.t: The first booking waiting for release; one note that no further check was booked while it is open.
you_see.src: check:05-12:envelope.persisted:calendar.event; check:05-12:envelope.persisted:clarification.request; dispatcher/listing_spokes_09.py::is not booked again: the last one is

test.t: A vacant listing is authorized to go live (it does not go live: no photos or description arrive); the daily run runs on days 1, 3 and 8.

title.t: A vacant listing is marked occupied

when.t: A vacant listing is marked occupied, or the listing ends.

steps.t: Agent 05 ends the vacancy watch and logs it; no more checks are asked for.

never.t: Keep ordering checks for an occupied home.

you_see.t: The end of the watch in the history.

test.t: A vacant listing is authorized to go live; two days later it is marked occupied; the daily run runs six days after that.
